about: The interactive suite (design section 6): 15 scripted conversations run on Marlowe and on Claude Code. Each step sends a user message; the driver answers ask_user questions, approvals, steers, interrupts and mode changes as written. A scenario passes when every check holds. Scenarios marked marlowe_only run on Marlowe and are not scored against Claude Code.

steps.say: Switch this app's storage backend away from sqlite. I have not decided between postgres and mysql, so ask me which one before you change anything, then update app.cfg.
Create a small python module named after my cat, containing `def meow(): return 'meow'`. I have not told you the cat's name, so ask me for it first.
Ask me which of these checks to enable: lint, types, tests. I may pick several. Then write the enabled ones, one per line, to checks.txt.
Rename the function `old_name` to `new_name` in util.py, and update the call in util.py.
Set the log level to debug in the config file.
Create hello.py that prints hello.

steer.say: Also make it print bye on a second line.

steps.say: Write the single word alpha into a.txt.

steer.say: Actually put it in b.txt instead, and remove a.txt if you already made it.

files.calc.py:

    return a - b

steps.say: calc.add is wrong. Fix it.

steer.say: When you are done, run pytest and quote its summary line in your answer.
